note: Grove Store. Local registry always works offline. Optional packages install from this registry or a configured local path. Listing and installing from Alexis's Supabase storage bucket uses existing env names only: SUPABASE_PRIMARY_URL or SUPABASE_URL, plus SUPABASE_ANON_KEY or SUPABASE_PRIMARY_KEY or SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY or SUPABASE_KEY, and optional SUPABASE_APP_BUCKET (defaults to synthia-apps). No credentials are stored here. Once an app is installed under the device install root, it stays usable without Supabase.
